Attached: 1 image

A voice agent's first word has a budget, and every hop spends it.
Audio transport ~40ms. Speech-to-text ~150ms. Model reasoning ~300ms. Text-to-speech ~180ms. First word out around ~700ms.
Stay under ~800ms and the conversation stops feeling like a walkie-talkie. This week's duplex-voice releases — Tencent's Gander, Gemini 3.8 Live — show the whole field now optimizing exactly this.
#VoiceAI #AIAgents
